title: Kinesio Tape vs Neuromuscular Stimulation For Conserative of Treatment Hemiplegic Shoulder
brief_summary: This study aimed to compare the effects of kinesiotaping, neuromuscular electric stimulation (NMES), and neuromuscular training on pain, and motor activity and function in patients with upper extremity hemiplegia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* had unilateral ischemic brain injury or intracerebral hemorrhage at least 1 week to maximum 24 months after the onset of single stroke without other diagnosed neurological or systematic deficits.
* had enough cognition to be able to follow the training protocol as assessed by Mini Mental State Examination.
* age 30-70 years.

Exclusion Criteria:

* had a severe injury of the rotator cuff or a shoulder surgery history.
